Elena (AE): Quick sync  SummitCare asked for a 2-week technical POC to validate QA accuracy + cost. Proposed kickoff Tue 09:30 CET. Can we confirm squad?
Ravi (SE): I'm in. We'll run hosted first, then Dedicated for final comparison. Need their labeled QA set and expected QPS.
Nina (Eng): For infra would suggest rwd-qa-v2-quant on hosted with prefix cache enabled. Prob 1xA10G equiv baseline, 2x for steady 30qps.
Omar (Security): They require EU residency and SOC2. I'll need SSQ v3 and a data flow diagram before we run production-like tests. KMS questions likely.
Priya (CS): I'll own the invite and demo sandbox. Can we expose a short demo URL for them to sanity-check?
Elena (AE): Their asks: p95 latency <= 350ms, accuracy F1 >= 0.78 on their eval, and ~50% cost reduction vs current vendor. They said steady 20qps, bursts to 60qps <5m.
Ravi (SE): Baseline plan: Week0 kickoff + dataset ingest, Week1 baseline + tuning, Week2 final eval & handoff. If on-prem needed, add 6-8 wks.
Nina (Eng): Success criteria to capture in kickoff: 1) end-to-end p95 <350ms at 20qps, 2) F1 >=0.78 on their test set, 3) cost per 10k queries <= target we compute.
Omar (Security): Action: send SSQ v3 template and list of required artifacts. Also confirm no PHI.
Priya (CS): Pricing note: they asked about committed vs burst. I'll prepare a short table with Hosted PAYG, 3mo/6mo Dedicated commit, and short-lived burst surcharge.
Ravi (SE): Operational checklist: create trial project, scoped API key, pin model, enable caching, set quotas, enable traces. I'll paste commands to shared doc.
calendar-bot: Meeting created: "SummitCare POC Kickoff" Tue 09:30 CET, 30m. Invites sent.
Elena (AE): Action items: Elena  confirm DPA timeline & collect PO contacts (due today). Ravi  infra runbook + demo sandbox (due Mon AM). Omar  security kickoff + SSQ (due Tue). Priya  pricing delta + invite list (due EOD).
Nina (Eng): One question  do they want logs forwarded to their SIEM? That affects retention and egress.
Elena (AE): I'll confirm and post answers here. Thanks team :rocket:
